items.title: The components of agent memory
items.summary: Anthropic explains that for Claude to learn from experience it must decide what is worth remembering before it knows what comes next, and describes how "dreaming" helps the model organize memory and correct mistakes.

items.title: Jais 3: Introducing Arabic-centric Agentic AI
items.title_zh: Jais 3：面向阿拉伯语的智能体 AI
items.summary: Jais 3 is a fleet of six open Arabic-centric agentic models from 0.9B to 375B parameters, adapted from the K2 Horizon fleet through continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, with a 512K-token context window on all but the smallest model. The authors say the 375B model is the largest open Arabic-centric model to date and release weights, stage checkpoints, data recipes, logs and evaluation code.

items.title: Ant launches Ling-3.2-flash multimodal model with million-token context
items.title_zh: 蚂蚁发布 Ling-3.2-flash 多模态模型，支持百万 token 上下文
items.summary: Ant Group released Ling-3.2-flash, a native multimodal model that accepts text, images and video, with 560 billion total parameters, 25 billion activated per inference and a one-million-token context window. TechNode reports it targets complex visual understanding, multistep agent tasks, 3D interaction and medical applications.

items.title: Compaction, decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation
items.title_zh: 两层对话记忆中的压缩、衰减与强化：与检索增强生成的配对评估
items.summary: The paper compares a two-tier conversational memory that compacts each turn into atomic facts against retrieval-augmented generation on LoCoMo, with both arms answering all 1,985 questions using the same stores, generator and judge. Compaction leads by 6.8 points (71.4% versus 64.6%) on four categories at 34% fewer prompt tokens, but the lead falls to a non-significant 2.0 points when an adversarial set is included, and reverses when answers require exact source wording.

items.title: CoRA-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation by Context Selectors Under Token Budgets
items.title_zh: CoRA-Bench：在 token 预算下评估上下文选择器的证据保留能力
items.summary: CoRA-Bench evaluates whether context selection methods preserve the evidence needed to answer a query under shared token budgets, comparing truncation, BM25, dense retrieval, reranking, LLMLingua-2 and Provence on BABILong, LOONG, NoLiMa and LongMemEval. It finds task-dependent tradeoffs, with method rankings varying across evidence types and between evidence recall and downstream accuracy.

items.title: AVCORP: Identifying and Resisting Deception via Communication Theory and Theory of Mind
items.title_zh: AVCORP：结合传播理论与心智理论识别并抵御欺骗
items.summary: AVCORP is a corpus of 5,000 annotated utterances from 250 games of Avalon, with 37 deception tactics mapped to a 4x4 behavior matrix and reasoning traces capturing abductive hypotheses, suspicion levels and nested theory-of-mind beliefs. A Qwen3-8B detector trained on it matches Claude Opus 5.5 on held-out games and beats GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Pro.

items.title: Flow-Guided Target-Space Alignment via Path Consistency
items.title_zh: 基于路径一致性的流引导目标空间对齐
items.summary: FlowAlign repurposes conditional flow matching as a training-time alignment signal that guides source-side representations toward a fixed target space while preserving paired correspondence and global target structure. Experiments on synthetic data, paired single-cell multiome benchmarks and image-text alignment show improved instance-level correspondence.

items.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
items.title_zh: 衡量 AI 智能体如何处理日常湿实验室科学
items.summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

items.title: Teaching AI to build scientific models
items.title_zh: 教 AI 构建科学模型
items.summary: In a guest post, Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon and Stefan Wahl discuss how AI is starting to change the scientific modeling process, from construction to interpretation.
